新增:- **G1 链路明细**:`chains` 单独一节(`Section` 的 title 用「链路明细」),每个产品一个 `Group`(`title` 写「产品 · 版本」),组按 `chains` 数组顺序上下排;组内按 `steps` 顺序排,每行一个 `FigureStrip`、最多放 3 步,超过 3 步的接着排下一行(仍在同一个 `Group` 里),每一步都要有图、不省略,整行在 9 列内放得下、不出现横向滚动;每张图的 `FigureLabel` 写「第 N 步 · 屏名」,`FigureText` 写「内容 · 操作 · 输入 K 项」,该步在 `issues` 里有记录时(问题的 `product` 等于该产品或为「全部」,且 `step` 等于该步的 `no`)在标签末尾加「 · 问题编号」(如「第 2 步 · 分享设置 · P1」,命中多条时用顿号隔开)。

请按这条规则修改 Page.tsx:只改和这条规则有关的地方,其他部分保持原样;如果页面已经符合这条规则,就不要改,直接结束。改了就运行检查。

Current Page.tsx: 流程明细 section uses one FigureStrip per chain with all steps. New rule G1 requires:
- Section title「链路明细」
- each product one Group (title「产品 · 版本」), groups in chains order
- within group, steps in order, each row one FigureStrip, max 3 steps per strip, overflow to next row, all in same Group
- each step has image, no omission, rows fit within 9 columns, no horizontal scroll
- FigureLabel: 「第 N 步 · 屏名」
- FigureText: 「内容 · 操作 · 输入 K 项」
- if step has issue record (issue.product == chain product or "全部", and issue.step == step.no), append 「 · 问题编号」 to the label (multiple joined with 、)

Also the note handling: currently there's an extra FigureText for note. G1 says FigureText writes 「内容 · 操作 · 输入 K 项」. Should I keep the note? Rule specifies FigureText content; keeping an extra FigureText for note may violate "FigureText 写「内容 · 操作 · 输入 K 项」". Safer to drop the note extra text to conform exactly. Hmm, but "只改和这条规则有关的地方" — the note is part of the 链路明细 section which the rule governs. I think removing the note text is safer for rule conformance. Actually the rule lists what the label and text contain, which implies exact content. I'll remove the note FigureText.

Wait — also FigureStrip width: Figure width is fixed by image (h fixed, ratio preserved). 3 phone screenshots 375×760 each — at what height? FigureImage fixed height... 3 images at 9 columns (1152*9/12 = 864px) — each figure would need ~280px wide. Phone ratio 375/760 → width = height * 0.493. If height is like 480, width ~237, three = 711 plus gaps, fits. The check will tell us.

Let me write the chunking helper: chunk steps into groups of 3.

Also note that FigureStrip is inside Group; Group children have 24px spacing.

Issue matching: build a map: for each product and step, collect issue ids where issue.product === chain.product || issue.product === "全部", and issue.step === step.no.

Let's write:

```tsx
const chunk = <T,>(arr: T[], size: number) =>
  arr.reduce<T[][]>((acc, item, i) => {
    if (i % size === 0) acc.push([])
    acc[acc.length - 1].push(item)
    return acc
  }, [])
```

Or simply:
```tsx
function chunk<T>(arr: T[], size: number): T[][] {
  const out: T[][] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) out.push(arr.slice(i, i + size))
  return out
}
```

Issue labels:
```tsx
const issuesFor = (product: string, no: number) =>
  data.issues.filter((it) => (it.product === product || it.product === "全部") && it.step === no).map((it) => it.id)
```

Then label: `第 ${step.no} 步 · ${step.screen}` + (ids.length ? ` · ${ids.join("、")}` : "")
